name: Karma
description: Employee recognition & rewards bot for Slack and Microsoft Teams — public/private kudos, analytics, gift-card rewards. ~$3/user/mo. NZ-listed on TrustMRR; G2 ~4.9.

mentions.evidence: ~$6.1k MRR, 263 active subscriptions, ~$24.5k L30, ~$725k all-time, ~14,000 users claimed, founded Jan 2024, New Zealand. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Build one Slack/Teams utility HR will budget for (recognition, PTO, standups, on-call) and charge per active seat.

whyItPrints: Workplace Slack apps that sit in the chat and meter seats. L30 (~$25k) far above seat-MRR (~$6k) suggests annual plans / rewards top-ups — still ~$725k all-time verified.
whyThisMatters:
Teams use Karma to give kudos in Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Telegram. There's a web app too. A thanks can be public or private. You get a simple read on recognition and on whether it matches the values you set. Rewards are gift cards, a group reward, or one you define yourself. They don't read, copy, or store your chats, and they say it meets GDPR. G2 has it at about 4.8.

Users include a SaaS team in Belgium, Spain, and the Philippines, an e-commerce company in Canada, a small agency in Mexico, and an education company in the UAE. People mention an easy fit with the tools they had, a remote team that feels more like a team, and a public way to say thanks. Price follows the number of active people in the workspace.

It's based in New Zealand and started in January 2024. You pay per person. The kudos and the gift cards live in the chat everyone already has open.
